source_evidence: REITs provide a way for individual investors to earn a share of the income produced through commercial real estate ownership – without actually having to go out and buy commercial real estate.
question: Misconception: To earn income from commercial real estate through a REIT, you must personally buy and manage the properties.
answer: Correction: A REIT lets individuals earn a share of income produced through commercial real estate without buying the properties themselves. The REIT owns and typically operates income-producing real estate or related assets.
